title: Qing China
html:
Qing China is an Asian country map in OpenFront by crunchybbb. It is the original Qing-dynasty-themed China map added in Update 33.0; when Update 34.0 redrew China with modern borders, the classic map was kept under this new name.

Nations

The map features 32 named nations, including British Hong Kong, Guangdong, Tannu Tuva, Boxer Rebellion, Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and Sichuan.
